title: プロジェクトデザインⅢ(直江伸至研究室)
subtitle: Design Project III(Naoe Nobuyuki)
educationalGoal: [Theme] Our laboratory projects focus on the design and control of rotating machines/electric installation to solve the environmental and energy problems. [Target] Through the projects, students will: (1) Learn how to find and solve technical issues. (2) Learn how to write a technical report and give a presentation.
advice: [Course Description] The project is collaboratively done by a team of two or more members. A weekly report should be prepared to show the progress of the project. A weekly meeting is also held using the weekly report. In the PD III final review, it is necessary to prepare a final report of the project and give a presentation. [Expectations for Students] This course is the final of Project Design activities and integrates knowledge and skills obtained at the other courses. Students are required to review the basic courses and to obtain expertise through the PD III.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of electromagnetics and electric circuits.

activityGoals.body: Be able to clearly define the goal of the project and to create a plan for achieving it.
Be able to communicate well with team members and to pursue the project.
Be able to solve technical challenges in the project by yourself.
Be able to compile results of the project as a final report (i.e., project report).
Be able to make presentations about results of the project effectively.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
